intentionalRigChanges: L_Toe and R_Toe added as children of the respective Foot bones, with smooth forefoot weights.
Torso added under Body with the same world rest matrix; both Upperarm bones reparented to Torso.
Eight existing Body vertex groups renamed Torso; their weights are unchanged.
Four legacy Actions removed; seven working clips remain.
limitations: Blender source and FBX roundtrip verification only; Unity Editor, Animator and Play Mode were not executed. Collision checks evaluate surface intersections at sampled times. Intended calf/boot connector contacts remain and were reviewed visually. The gait is a stylized hop with short legs; 0.8 m/s is a tunable reference, not a guarantee of exact foot locking.
